```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(stringr)

dir.create("data/clean", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

study_countries <- c(
  "Saudi Arabia", "Iraq", "Iran", "Kuwait",
  "United Arab Emirates", "Qatar", "Syria", "Yemen"
)

save_dual_crs <- function(sf_obj, file_path) {
  saveRDS(
    list(
      crs_4326 = st_transform(sf_obj, 4326),
      crs_3857 = st_transform(sf_obj, 3857)
    ),
    file_path
  )
}

# =============================================================================
# 1. ACLED
# =============================================================================

acled_raw <- read_xlsx("data/Middle-East_aggregated_data_up_to-2026-03-07.xlsx")

acled_clean <- acled_raw %>%
  filter(COUNTRY %in% study_countries) %>%
  mutate(
    WEEK = as.Date(WEEK)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(CENTROID_LONGITUDE),
    !is.na(CENTROID_LATITUDE)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("CENTROID_LONGITUDE", "CENTROID_LATITUDE"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

save_dual_crs(acled_clean, "data/clean/acled_clean.rds")

cat(
  "✓ ACLED:",
  nrow(acled_clean), "rows across",
  n_distinct(acled_clean$COUNTRY), "countries\n"
)

# =============================================================================
# 2. GEM — Oil / NGL Pipelines
# =============================================================================


gem_raw <- st_read("data/GEM-GOIT-Oil-NGL-Pipelines-2025-03.geojson")

gem_clean <- gem_raw %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      coalesce(Countries, ""),
      regex(str_c(study_countries, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)
    ) |
      StartCountry %in% study_countries |
      EndCountry %in% study_countries
  ) %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%        # drop the 457 empty geometries
  st_transform(4326) %>%                    # ensure CRS is 4326
  select(ProjectID, PipelineName, Countries, Status,
         Capacity, CapacityUnits, LengthMergedKm,
         StartLocation, StartCountry,
         EndLocation,   EndCountry,
         RouteType, RouteAccuracy, LastUpdated,
         geometry)

# projected version for distance calculations
gem_3857 <- st_transform(gem_clean, 3857)

saveRDS(gem_clean, "data/clean/gem_clean.rds")
saveRDS(gem_3857,  "data/clean/gem_3857.rds")

cat("✓ GEM:", nrow(gem_clean), "pipelines |",
    n_distinct(gem_clean$Countries), "country entries\n")
cat("✓ CRS:", st_crs(gem_clean)$epsg, "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 3. Natural Earth populated places
# =============================================================================

places_raw <- ne_download(
  scale = 10,
  type = "populated_places",
  category = "cultural",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

# Check names(places_raw) if this ever fails in your environment
places_clean <- places_raw %>%
  filter(ADM0NAME %in% study_countries)

save_dual_crs(places_clean, "data/clean/places_clean.rds")

cat("✓ Populated places:", nrow(places_clean), "rows saved\n")

# =============================================================================
# 4. Natural Earth country boundaries
# =============================================================================

countries_raw <- ne_download(
  scale = 10,
  type = "admin_0_countries",
  category = "cultural",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

countries_clean <- countries_raw %>%
  filter(ADMIN %in% study_countries)

save_dual_crs(countries_clean, "data/clean/countries_clean.rds")

cat("✓ Country boundaries:", nrow(countries_clean), "rows saved\n")

# =============================================================================
# 5. Example load for teammates
# =============================================================================

# ACLED
acled_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/acled_clean.rds")
acled_4326 <- acled_obj$crs_4326
acled_3857 <- acled_obj$crs_3857

# Places
places_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/places_clean.rds")
places_4326 <- places_obj$crs_4326
places_3857 <- places_obj$crs_3857

# Countries
countries_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/countries_clean.rds")
countries_4326 <- countries_obj$crs_4326
countries_3857 <- countries_obj$crs_3857

# GEM
gem_clean <- readRDS("data/clean/gem_clean.rds")
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(lubridate)

# =============================================================================
# 1. Load cleaned data
# =============================================================================

acled_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/acled_clean.rds")
places_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/places_clean.rds")
countries_obj <- readRDS("data/clean/countries_clean.rds")
gem_clean <- readRDS("data/clean/gem_clean.rds")

acled_4326 <- acled_obj$crs_4326
acled_3857 <- acled_obj$crs_3857

places_4326 <- places_obj$crs_4326
places_3857 <- places_obj$crs_3857

countries_4326 <- countries_obj$crs_4326
countries_3857 <- countries_obj$crs_3857

# =============================================================================
# 2. Basic checks
# =============================================================================

cat("========== BASIC CHECKS ==========\n\n")

cat("ACLED object class:\n")
print(class(acled_4326))
cat("\n")

cat("Places object class:\n")
print(class(places_4326))
cat("\n")

cat("Countries object class:\n")
print(class(countries_4326))
cat("\n")

cat("GEM object class:\n")
print(class(gem_clean))
cat("\n")

cat("ACLED CRS:", st_crs(acled_4326)$epsg, "\n")
cat("Places CRS:", st_crs(places_4326)$epsg, "\n")
cat("Countries CRS:", st_crs(countries_4326)$epsg, "\n\n")

cat("ACLED rows:", nrow(acled_4326), "\n")
cat("Places rows:", nrow(places_4326), "\n")
cat("Countries rows:", nrow(countries_4326), "\n")
cat("GEM rows:", nrow(gem_clean), "\n\n")

cat("Countries in ACLED:\n")
print(sort(unique(acled_4326$COUNTRY)))
cat("\n")

cat("Countries in boundaries:\n")
print(sort(unique(countries_4326$ADMIN)))
cat("\n")

cat("Countries in places:\n")
print(sort(unique(places_4326$ADM0NAME)))
cat("\n")

# =============================================================================
# 3. Period available for ACLED
# =============================================================================

cat("========== ACLED TIME COVERAGE ==========\n\n")

cat("Min week:", as.character(min(acled_4326$WEEK, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Max week:", as.character(max(acled_4326$WEEK, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Number of unique weeks:", n_distinct(acled_4326$WEEK), "\n\n")

acled_year_summary <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(year = year(WEEK)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

print(acled_year_summary)

# =============================================================================
# 4. Country-level summaries
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== COUNTRY SUMMARIES ==========\n\n")

country_summary <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_week = min(WEEK, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_week = max(WEEK, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_admin1 = n_distinct(ADMIN1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_events))

print(country_summary)

# =============================================================================
# 5. Event type summaries
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== EVENT TYPE SUMMARIES ==========\n\n")

event_type_summary <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_events))

print(event_type_summary)

sub_event_summary <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(SUB_EVENT_TYPE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_events))

print(head(sub_event_summary, 15))

# =============================================================================
# 6. GEM quick checks
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== GEM CHECKS ==========\n\n")

cat("Unique fuel types:\n")
print(sort(unique(gem_clean$Fuel)))
cat("\n")

gem_country_summary <- gem_clean %>%
  mutate(
    country_focus = case_when(
      StartCountry %in% countries_4326$ADMIN ~ StartCountry,
      EndCountry %in% countries_4326$ADMIN ~ EndCountry,
      TRUE ~ Countries
    )
  ) %>%
  count(country_focus, sort = TRUE)

print(gem_country_summary)

gem_status_summary <- gem_clean %>%
  count(Status, sort = TRUE)

print(gem_status_summary)

# =============================================================================
# 7. Simple plots
# =============================================================================

theme_set(theme_minimal())

# 7.1 Events per country
p1 <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(COUNTRY, total_events), y = total_events)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total ACLED Events by Country",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total events"
  )

print(p1)

# 7.2 Fatalities per country
p2 <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(total_fatalities = sum(FATALITIES, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(COUNTRY, total_fatalities), y = total_fatalities)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Fatalities by Country",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total fatalities"
  )

print(p2)

# 7.3 Weekly events over time
p3 <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(WEEK) %>%
  summarise(total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = WEEK, y = total_events)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Conflict Events Over Time",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Total events"
  )

print(p3)

# 7.4 Weekly events by country
p4 <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(WEEK, COUNTRY) %>%
  summarise(total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = WEEK, y = total_events)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ COUNTRY, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Conflict Events by Country",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Total events"
  )

print(p4)

# 7.5 Event type totals
p5 <- acled_4326 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE) %>%
  summarise(total_events = sum(EVENTS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(EVENT_TYPE, total_events), y = total_events)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Events by Event Type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total events"
  )

print(p5)

# =============================================================================
# 8. Simple maps
# =============================================================================

# 8.1 Boundaries + populated places + ACLED points
p6 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries_4326, fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = places_4326, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = acled_4326, size = 0.4, alpha = 0.25) +
  labs(
    title = "Study Area: Countries, Cities, and ACLED Conflict Points"
  )

print(p6)

# 8.2 ACLED points by country
p7 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries_4326, fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = acled_4326, aes(color = COUNTRY), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(
    title = "ACLED Conflict Points by Country",
    color = "Country"
  )

print(p7)

# 8.3 GEM pipelines
p8 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries_4326, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = gem_clean, aes(color = Status), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "operating"   = "#1D9E75",
    "proposed"    = "#378ADD",
    "construction"= "#EF9F27",
    "cancelled"   = "#E24B4A",
    "shelved"     = "#888780"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Oil & Gas Pipelines — Global Energy Monitor",
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p8)

# 8.4 GEM pipelines + ACLED conflict points together
p9 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries_4326, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = gem_clean, color = "#1D9E75", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = acled_4326, aes(color = EVENT_TYPE), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Pipelines and Conflict Events",
    color = "Event type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p9)

# =============================================================================
# 9. Optional: save plots
# =============================================================================

# ggsave("outputs/fatalities_by_country.png", p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# ggsave("outputs/events_by_type.png", p5, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
